deployment.reason: The installed stack is NixOS/Home Manager managed; sudo -n requires a password.
deployment.next_command_behavior: Snapshots and rechecks the current /etc/nixos graph before activation, then restarts all five daemons and Shelllist. It includes tracked worktree edits; review them before authorizing.
deployment.rollback_scope: The complete previous system closure includes every currently running Shelllist/daemon executable. A GC root preserves it; rollback activation has not been exercised.

native_and_packaged_qml.skip_reason: Media artwork pixel check requires an RHI renderer; these runs use the software renderer.

validation.build_inputs: aligned: Rust 1.95.0, 10 locked roots, 44 shared dependencies

coverage_limit: The coordinated v2 envelope migration covers all five D-Bus daemons. Rust-derived method payload schemas remain the app and bar/audio pilot, not complete schema coverage of every daemon method.
